question: What relative lengths are shown in Figure 6B-2 for a merging taper, shifting taper, and shoulder taper?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Figure 6B-2 shows the merging taper with a full taper length of "L," each shifting taper with a length of "½ L," and the shoulder taper with a length of "⅓ L." These relative lengths align with the Guidance in Section 6B.08, which recommends approximately ½ L for shifting tapers and approximately ⅓ L for shoulder tapers, with the base taper length L calculated per Tables 6B-3 and 6B-4. Guidance (recommended): - "The appropriate taper length (L) should be determined using the criteria shown in Tables 6B-3 and 6B-4." - "A merging taper should be long enough to enable merging drivers to have adequate advance warning and sufficient length to adjust their speeds and merge into an adjacent lane before the downstream end of the transition." - "A shifting taper should have a length of approximately ½ L (see Tables 6B-3 and 6B-4)." - "If used, shoulder tapers should have a length of approximately ¹⁄3 L (see Tables 6B-3 and 6B-4). If a shoulder is used as a travel lane, either through practice or during a TTC activity, a normal merging or shifting taper should be used." - "If used, a downstream taper should have a minimum length of 50 feet and a maximum length of 100 feet with devices placed at a spacing of approximately 20 feet." (shown as an optional element in the figure) Options (permitted): - The lateral buffer space may be used to separate the traffic space from the work space, as shown in Figures 6B-1 and 6B-2. Visual evidence: [Image 1] Figure 6B-2 depicts a merging taper labeled "L," shifting tapers labeled "1/2 L," a shoulder taper labeled "1/3 L," a tangent section labeled "4S ft*" (where S = speed in mph), and an optional downstream taper, along with optional longitudinal and lateral buffer spaces. Citations: - Figure 6B-2 (p.774) - Section 6B.08 Guidance §4 (p.775) - Section 6B.08 Guidance §6 (p.776) - Section 6B.08 Guidance §8 (p.776) - Section 6B.08 Guidance §10 (p.776) - Section 6B.08 Guidance §12 (p.776) - Section 6B.06 Option §14 (p.775)
gold_answer: Merging taper: L; shifting taper: 1/2 L; shoulder taper: 1/3 L.
